import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
BEFORE=Path(os.environ["SIDEBAR_BEFORE_EXE"])
AFTER=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
PROFILE=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])

def until(fn,why,timeout=30):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(why)

def env_for(name):
    root=ROOT/"logs"/name
    if root.exists():shutil.rmtree(root)
    (root/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root/"appdata").mkdir()
    (root/"temp").mkdir()
    (root/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
        "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n",
        encoding="ascii",newline="")
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(root/"localappdata")
    env["APPDATA"]=str(root/"appdata")
    env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(root/"temp")
    return env

def launch(exe,name,expect_artwork):
    proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(PROFILE)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env_for(name))
    win=None
    try:
        def getwin():
            if proc.poll() is not None:return None
            ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid)
                if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
            return ws[0] if len(ws)==1 else None
        win=until(getwin,name+" window missing",25)
        try:win.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
        except Exception:pass
        if expect_artwork:
            def ready():
                imgs=[]
                for x in win.descendants():
                    try:
                        if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and (
                           x.element_info.name or "").startswith(
                           "Windows Known Folder sidebar artwork:"):
                            if x.is_visible() and x.rectangle().width()>0:
                                imgs.append(x)
                    except Exception:pass
                return imgs if len(imgs)==6 else None
            imgs=until(ready,"six sidebar artwork images not visible",20)
            print("AFTER_SIDEBAR_ARTWORK_COUNT",len(imgs),flush=True)
            for x in imgs:
                r=x.rectangle()
                print("AFTER_SIDEBAR_ARTWORK",x.element_info.name,
                      r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),flush=True)
        else:
            time.sleep(2)
            count=0
            for x in win.descendants():
                try:
                    if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and (
                       x.element_info.name or "").startswith(
                       "Windows Known Folder sidebar artwork:"):
                        count+=1
                except Exception:pass
            print("BEFORE_SIDEBAR_ARTWORK_COUNT",count,flush=True)
            if count!=0:raise AssertionError("before revision unexpectedly exposes sidebar artwork")
        img=win.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
        # Navigation column is 188 px at this width; include a small margin.
        crop=img.crop((0,0,min(215,img.width),img.height))
        return crop,proc,win
    except Exception:
        if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate()
        raise

def close(proc,win,label):
    if proc.poll() is None:
        c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
        try:proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=8)
    print(label+"_EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

before_img,bp,bw=launch(BEFORE,"sidebar-before-env",False)
close(bp,bw,"BEFORE")
after_img,ap,aw=launch(AFTER,"sidebar-after-env",True)
close(ap,aw,"AFTER")

# Explorer reference navigation pane.
desktop=Desktop(backend="uia")
known=set()
for w in desktop.windows(control_type="Window"):
    try:
        if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
            known.add(w.handle)
    except Exception:pass
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(PROFILE)])
ew=None
try:
    def getexp():
        for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
            try:
                if w.handle in known:continue
                if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
                    return w
            except Exception:pass
        return None
    ew=until(getexp,"Explorer window missing",20)
    try:ew.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    time.sleep(2)
    eimg=ew.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    explorer_img=eimg.crop((0,0,min(260,eimg.width),eimg.height))
finally:
    if ew is not None:
        try:ew.close()
        except Exception:pass

h=max(before_img.height,after_img.height,explorer_img.height)
w=max(before_img.width,after_img.width,explorer_img.width)
sheet=Image.new("RGB",(w*3,h+28),"white")
sheet.paste(before_img,(0,28))
sheet.paste(after_img,(w,28))
sheet.paste(explorer_img,(w*2,28))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
d.text((8,8),"BEFORE glyph sidebar",fill="black")
d.text((w+8,8),"AFTER native artwork",fill="black")
d.text((w*2+8,8),"Explorer reference",fill="black")
buf=io.BytesIO();sheet.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=86,optimize=True)
print("SIDEBAR_CONTACT_SHEET_BEGIN",flush=True)
print(base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii"),flush=True)
print("SIDEBAR_CONTACT_SHEET_END",flush=True)
print("SIDEBAR_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS",flush=True)
